summary: Ninth consolidated daily run. News sweep of 2026-10-26 to 2026-10-28: the Federal Register issue of 2026-10-28 carried Proclamation 11074 on wind turbine imports (91 FR 68001) and Executive Order 14438 on housing costs (91 FR 68007), both signed 2026-10-22 and already recorded from whitehouse.gov, now cited in the Federal Register (c26-04, c15-13); a Defense Production Act determination on petroleum capacity, an ONC deregulatory rule on health IT certification and an Office of Government Ethics disclosure rule map to no tracked record. The whitehouse.gov presidential actions page showed nothing after 2026-10-23 and the Supreme Court orders page nothing after 2026-10-21. VA reported on 2026-10-26 that the Cleveland and Anchorage electronic health record go-lives took place (c20-05). Fourteen watch items were checked with no new action. Rotation: six freshness checks on Foreword records (c00-14, c00-12, c00-05, c00-11, c00-02, c00-18), each gaining primary or qualifying sources in place of lead-only hosts or corrections, with c00-18 court status moved from stayed to pending on the strength of sibling records; four refutation checks on records counted as in effect (c05-30, c12-10, c11-08, c04-03) all hold, and c11-08 court status was corrected from upheld to pending. All 13 changed records were independently reviewed. No stage changed; counts unchanged. No pending requests; lead L22 rechecked and three new retrieval leads (L23 to L25) recorded for pages that could not be opened in this run. About 48 of 120 searches used. Export to GitHub paused.
